The bus was twenty minutes late, which is normal for this route on a Friday, so I read half a chapter standing at the stop and finished it on the ride. Not a great book. I'll probably still finish it, because I hate leaving things half-read even when I'm not enjoying them, which says more about me than the book.

Work was fine. My manager asked if I could take on the Peterson account next quarter and I said yes before really thinking about it, which is either confidence or exhaustion, hard to tell which some days.

Dinner was leftovers. Rice, the good kind of leftovers where the flavors settled in overnight.
